title: The web panel, API rate limits and the security review's tests pass CI on main
claim: The web panel with Telegram sign-in, desktop layouts and the owner's back office (story S15.1, pull request 40), rate limits per signed-in user and per shop (pull request 39) and the security review with its tests (story S19.2, pull request 41) passed CI on main in the run for commit 373243d; the runs for the first two merges alone were cancelled when the next merge superseded them. The panel was exercised against a fake server and a stub of the Telegram widget only. The review found no critical or high finding in what it read and lists what it did not read; it is an agent's review, and launch criterion 7 still needs a person
